note: Subtler planted defects than the first review case, each demonstrated by running its logic before it was planted. A finding hits a defect when its quote contains the anchor text or any "also" anchor, or its line number is one of those anchors' lines. clean-*.ps1 files have no planted defects: every finding there is a candidate false alarm, to be read by a person. Anchors were fixed before any model reviewed these files.

defects.what: version names sorted as text: 1.9.0 sorts above 1.10.0
$Count is a string, so '10' -gt 9 is False and 10 workers pass a limit-9 check
-or deletes every old log and every big log; the comment says old AND big
-Path treats [1] as a wildcard, so app[1].config is reported as not found
ErrorActionPreference Stop doesn't stop on a failed native command, so a broken build is tagged and reported as finished
-replace takes a regex: '1.5' also replaces '1x5', and $ in the new text is special
